name: Aizawa Shinobu
source:
Physique: Breasts are on the large side, yet she is quite slim. Appears to carry no extra weight besides her breasts.
Hobbies: Collecting cute accessories, handicrafts in general.
Skills: Laborous work. Also she's a hefty drinker who can hold her liquor.
Weaknesses: Anything requiring quick wits and swiftness, precision machines (she can't even schedule a video recording.)

She is [url=/c82856]the protagonist[/url]'s classmate and also [url=/c82857]Shin'ichi[/url]'s cousin. Her family are tangerine farmers as well as major landowners with ownership of a single mountain.

She has a calm demeanor but is nevertheless a hard worker who gives her all. She minds her manners and rarely loses her temper. What she lacks in agility, she makes up for in considerable endurance and strength. She can do anything as well as the average person, but only because of her daily efforts. She is the honor student type who stays clear of doing "bad things." She serves as a mediator who can gently make both pushy girls and frivolous guys alike settle down, one way or the other.

[Translated from [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item12965]Gyutto[/url]]
